supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the outer boundaries of the eye orbits.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle area is significantly lighter in pixel intensity compared to the dark cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Significant vertical thickness with a visible structural droop in the center of the lower lip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two small, distinct white spots on the lower lip.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white hair distribution (beard) across the lower muzzle and chin.
